paired.scope: Paired development UID resampling, frozen calibration map/coefficients/thresholds; no claim to include calibration uncertainty or training seed variability.

costs.assumptions: counts/latent/native responses already available from frozen C; current implementation computes even masked blocks; casts/memory traffic not FLOPs
costs.total_scope: checks complete in ordinary arithmetic, sqrt/comparisons separate. Preparation leading terms only; C preparation/backfill/native query acquisition/summary overhead not assumed zero. Total is a lower bound, not a complete serving ledger.
costs.existing_teacher_scope: 512 calibration UID residuals from retained Current-at-decision Exact panels; no new teacher computation. Original teacher/preparation cost records remain dependencies.

calibration.note: OOF quantiles are frozen; final-in-sample is only a shift diagnostic, not held-out performance.
